rubric: See ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT_2026-10.md: 1–2 critical missing control, 3–4 documented/partial, 5–6 implemented and tested with runtime blind spots, 7–8 measured operational recovery, 9–10 independently validated. Null means not assessed.

dimensions.name: Cohesion and modularity
dimensions.evidence: Separate production, research and QuantLab modules; shared repository

dimensions.name: Coupling and shared state
dimensions.evidence: Production engine and QuantLab collector resolve to the same DB host, database and credentials; DB grants unknown

dimensions.name: Data lineage and temporal leakage
dimensions.evidence: available_at and append-only migrations 025–026; runtime samples unknown

dimensions.name: Test coverage and reliability
dimensions.evidence: 151 test files and PR CI; coverage and flaky trend unknown

dimensions.name: CI and release hygiene
dimensions.evidence: PR CI and predeploy migrations; docs-only PR #243 merge triggered KellyLab production deploy; branch rules unknown

dimensions.name: Rollback and recoverability
dimensions.evidence: No restore exercise, RPO or RTO evidence

dimensions.name: Observability and alerting
dimensions.evidence: Health/readiness and worker dashboard; alert delivery unknown

dimensions.name: Incident handling
dimensions.evidence: Diagnostics exist; central owner/lifecycle record absent

dimensions.name: Security and least privilege
dimensions.evidence: Production and QuantLab share DB credentials; effective grants and other access boundaries not inspected

dimensions.name: DB migrations, backup and retention
dimensions.evidence: 75 migration files; PITR disabled on both Railway PostgreSQL services; other backups and restore unverified

dimensions.name: Runtime cost and API budgets
dimensions.evidence: Shared football envelope documented; measured usage and bill unknown

dimensions.name: Deploy complexity
dimensions.evidence: 48 Railway definitions, 14 cron, 17 without Git source ref

dimensions.name: Single points of failure
dimensions.evidence: One PostgreSQL definition per project; Railway HA status isCluster=false for both; restore unverified

dimensions.name: Scalability
dimensions.evidence: No load, queue-lag or saturation measurements

dimensions.name: Maintainability
dimensions.evidence: Change protocol and tests; Baseball documentation drift

dimensions.name: Operational cognitive load
dimensions.evidence: 48 definitions across two projects, including one-shot and cron

risks.title: Football Production and QuantLab use the same DB credentials; effective grants unknown
risks.evidence: Read-only Railway variable comparison 2026-10-10; values redacted
risks.action: Read-only DB role/grant review, then propose separate credentials

risks.title: Many long-lived diagnostic definitions lack source ownership
risks.action: Assign lifecycle/owner before any retirement proposal

risks.title: Backup restore is not demonstrated
risks.evidence: Railway PITR disabled on both DBs; other backup and restore evidence absent
risks.action: Confirm backup inventory, retention and isolated restore exercise

risks.title: Deployment status may be mistaken for job or data health; Baseball cold storage later shows CRASHED
risks.evidence: Two observed Railway fixtures show SUCCESS to CRASHED and cron instance drift
risks.action: Review last job log/freshness; track process, job and data separately

risks.title: Baseball README and PostgreSQL runtime contract diverge
Older Basketball service points at a module absent from its source ref; v1/v2 coexistence lacks retirement evidence
risks.evidence: Railway quantbet-basketball source/start module versus quantbet-baseball tree at ed2e1c4
risks.action: Confirm last successful run and consumers before proposing simplification

risks.title: h2h documented workflows not present at reviewed HEAD
Main merge triggers production deployment even for documentation-only changes
risks.evidence: PR #243 merge SHA 4842946 matched KellyLab Railway deployment at 11:58 UTC
risks.action: Require explicit deployment-impact approval before merging PR #244; review auto-deploy/watch configuration
